modalities.evidence: HR values reported by ECG (Bittium Faros)
wearables including Biovotion Everion, Empatica E4, Apple Watch

output.population: 53 participants with differing skin tones, recorded July-August 2019
output.summary: Heart rate values from a chest ECG device compared with several consumer wearables during sitting, deep breathing, walking and typing, with activity, skin tone and subject ID; de-identified and time-synced.
